resources.string: Save public playlists and song information to local playlists. Audio is not downloaded; playback still requires an available audio source.
Enter the numeric user ID from a NetEase profile to read its public playlists.
Enter a valid numeric user ID.
Could not find the signed-in user ID. Enter it manually or sign in again.
Save locally and keep a source record, without following future changes.
Refresh manually in import tasks, or enable daily refresh to add new songs.
Keep the source linked after import
No readable public playlists. Check the user ID, playlist visibility, and sign-in status, then try again.
%1$d import tasks queued. You can follow their progress here.
%1$d tasks queued; %2$d could not be queued. The remaining playlists stay selected. Return to Choose playlists to retry.
Tasks are saved and can continue after you close this screen. Imported content appears in Library under Local playlists.
No import tasks yet. Choose public playlists to get started.
Could not read import tasks. Please retry.
This stops the current import and disables refresh for this source. Saved local playlists and song information are kept. You can select and link this playlist again later.
Import cancelled. Saved content is kept.
No songs are ready to retry, or the retry delay has not passed. Check the task and failed-song details.
This source is not linked yet, or has been unlinked. Select it again and choose Keep source linked.
Source unlinked. Local content is kept.
Shown in the original playlist order. A NetEase song ID is shown when the song name is unavailable.
Could not read failed-song details. Please retry.
No failed-song details remain. A retry may have imported the songs successfully.
Offline mode is enabled. You can view saved tasks. Disable offline mode to read playlists or retry.
Reading public playlists still requires a NetEase sign-in. Sign in from Settings, then return to read playlists or retry tasks.
The signed-in account changed. Confirm your NetEase account, then retry.
Access denied. Check whether the playlist is public.
The remote playlist or song is unavailable or has been removed.
NetEase returned incomplete information. Import has stopped for now; please retry later.
Cannot reach NetEase right now. Check your connection and retry later.
Could not save locally. Check available storage and retry.
The local playlist was deleted. The import task for this source cannot continue.
The operation could not be completed. Please retry later.
Some songs could not be imported
